description: Server-side code patterns and architectural best practices

patterns.name: BUN_SERVE_EXPORT_PATTERN
patterns.description: Bun.serve binding pattern using export default { port, fetch } to bind Hono app to specific port
patterns.notes: This is the correct pattern for Bun runtime. Do NOT use app.listen() or manual createServer() - Bun expects the export default with { port, fetch } signature.

patterns.name: HONO_ERROR_HANDLER_PATTERN
patterns.description: Production error handling with app.onError and app.notFound for all route types
patterns.notes: app.onError catches errors that middleware and interceptors miss. Must check HTTPException separately to allow specific HTTP errors through.

patterns.name: HONO_UNIT_TEST_PATTERN
patterns.description: Use createTestApp() helper to recreate route handlers in test without importing index.ts directly
patterns.notes: Cannot import index.ts directly because it runs migrations and loads env at module level. createTestApp() pattern avoids side effects while testing routing logic.

patterns.name: ENV_PORT_COERCE_PATTERN
patterns.description: Use z.coerce.number().int().default(3000) for PORT env var since env vars are strings
patterns.notes: z.coerce.number() converts string '3000' to number 3000. .default(3000) provides fallback if PORT is undefined.

patterns.name: ENV_DATABASE_URL_VALIDATION
patterns.description: Use .refine() to validate DATABASE_URL starts with 'file:', 'libsql://', or 'http' for different backend types
patterns.codeExample:
DATABASE_URL: z
  .string()
  .min(1)
  .refine(
    (url) =>
      url.startsWith('file:') ||
      url.startsWith('libsql://') ||
      url.startsWith('http'),
    {
      message:
        'DATABASE_URL must start with "file:" for SQLite, "libsql://" for Turso, or "http" for remote',
    },
  ),
patterns.notes: Custom refine message tells developers exactly what formats are valid. Prevents silent failures from malformed DATABASE_URL.

architectural_notes.migration_setup: Run migrations on startup (top of index.ts) but exit with error code 1 if they fail - don't silently proceed
architectural_notes.middleware_order: 1) logger(), 2) cors(), 3) auth handler, 4) rpc/api handlers, 5) health check, then notFound/onError
architectural_notes.handler_export: Export apiHandler and rpcHandler separately so they can be imported by test suite or reused elsewhere
architectural_notes.port_binding: NEVER use app.listen() - always export default { port, fetch } for Bun compatibility
